meta.name: writing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为可执行的多步骤计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在写代码前把模糊需求变成清晰步骤
copy.tagline_en: Turn specs into actionable multi-step plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn vague requirements into clear steps before coding

howto.what: 根据规格或需求，生成一份详细的实现计划，包含文件结构、任务分解（每个任务含测试、实现、提交步骤），并保存到指定目录。计划中必须包含实际代码，无占位符。Claude 会声明正在使用此技能。
howto.when: 当用户提供一个多步任务的规格或需求，且在编写代码之前。典型触发：用户要求为某个功能制定实现计划。

say.text: 请根据这个需求生成实现计划。
say.note: Claude 会输出完整计划并保存。

say.text: 在写代码之前，先帮我写一个多步骤的实施计划。
say.note: Claude 会创建包含文件结构和任务分解的计划。

say.text: 为这个新功能规划实现步骤，包括测试和文件修改。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合 TDD 风格的计划。

howto.what_en: Generate a detailed implementation plan from a spec or requirements, including file structure, task decomposition (each task with test, implementation, commit steps), and save to a designated directory. Plans must contain actual code, no placeholders. Claude will announce it is using this skill.
howto.when_en: When the user provides a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before writing code. Typical trigger: user asks to create an implementation plan for a feature.

say_en.text: Generate an implementation plan based on this requirement.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a full plan and saves it.

say_en.text: Before coding, write a multi-step implementation plan for me.
say_en.note: Claude creates a plan with file structure and task breakdown.

say_en.text: Plan the implementation steps for this new feature, including tests and file modifications.
